subject: Inbound: Pilot demo — usage, peak concurrency & scheduling
messages:
From: Samira Patel <samira@selfserve.ai>
To: marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 15 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick demo? Pilot for search relevance at scale

Hi Marcus,

I signed up for Redwood's self-serve last week (liked the quick start!). We're a small infra/AI team at SelfServe AI running real-time product search with an NLU re-ranker. We're interested in a short pilot to validate latency and cost at our 10k daily active users profile.

A few quick things that would help us decide whether to move forward:
- Typical token length: queries ~8-20 tokens, reranker context ~100-400 tokens.
- Peak concurrency: during product drops we see short bursts up to ~140 concurrent inference requests for ~5-10 minutes.
- Timeline: we'd like to run a 2-week pilot in April to test stability under burst.

Can we schedule a 30-min demo next week to walk through best practices for batching, KV caching, and model selection? Also curious if you can share an expected cost ballpark for our profile.

Thanks,
Samira
Samira Patel
Head of ML, SelfServe AI
samira@selfserve.ai
(Attachment: example-query-sample.json - 1KB)
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>

Cc: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Mar 2028 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick demo? Pilot for search relevance at scale

Hi Samira — great to meet you and thanks for signing up. Happy to run through pilot options and give a practical cost/latency estimate. A couple of quick qualification questions so we tailor the session: 

1) Traffic shape: is the 10k DAU evenly spread or concentrated in pockets? You mentioned drops — roughly how often per week do those bursts happen and what's the typical duration?

2) Reranker model size: are you currently using a transformer-based reranker (e.g., 1B-3B parameters) or a smaller linear model? If unsure, a rough tensor size or model name helps.

3) SLOs: target p95/p99 latency goals for user-facing requests? Are tail latencies more important than throughput for you?

4) Data/security: Will you need a private deployment or is hosted OK for the pilot?

Proposed slots (30-min):
- Tue 3/21 11:00am PT
- Wed 3/22 2:30pm PT
- Thu 3/23 9:00am PT

If none of those work I can loop in Avery from our Solutions team to handle timezone-friendly options. Also, if you can share a small traffic sample (CSV or anonymized requests), we can run a quick cost estimate beforehand.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

From: Samira Patel <samira@selfserve.ai>

Cc: Eli Gomez <eli@selfserve.ai>
Date: Thu, 15 Mar 2028 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick demo? Pilot for search relevance at scale

Thanks Marcus — answers inline below. Forwarding Eli (platform engineer) who will own the pilot infra side.

1) Traffic shape: our traffic is mostly long-tail, but we have 2-3 scheduled product drops per month that create those 5-10 minute bursts. Baseline concurrency ~10-20, bursts up to 140 for 6-8 minutes.

2) Reranker: currently using a distilled transformer (approx 700M params) served via a small Kubernetes fleet. We're open to trying a 1B quantized open model if gains justify cost.

3) SLOs: target p95 ~120ms, p99 <350ms. Tail matters — user experience degrades quickly when rerank is slow.

4) Security: hosted is fine for the pilot, but we'll likely need Dedicated for production.

Attaching a lightweight traffic sample and a rough network diagram.

Samira
(Attachments: traffic-estimates.xlsx, network-diagram.png)

We'll prepare a rough cost projection and a short runbook for the two-week pilot before the meeting.
